No
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 502
Date 8/8/16
Shanghai Municipal Council.
August 7th 1916
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

Sir,
A bomb exploded at No.30 Rue Soong Chian.
The house is at present occupied by a Chinese tailor
but was formerly occupied by revolutionaries
and it is thought that the bomb was left on
the premises by these. The explosion did not do
serious damage. The occupant was seriously injured.
At a meeting held by the City Volunteers yesterday
they elected Li Ping Shu as their President.
He declined to accept the post. Another meeting
will soon be held in the theatre on the Chinese Bund.
A military detective has reported to General
Yang that Woosung is liable to sever its connection
with the Central Government at any moment. He also
reported that Deputy Military Governor Liu has
recently purchased 2,000 rifles on his own.
Two hundred men were sent to increase the
garrison of Zau Woo Kyung 漕涇馬 village on 6th inst.
At 1 a.m. 6th inst while patrolling Sicawei
village a Chinese police inspector tried to arrest a
robber. The latter shot the officer in the thigh
and escaped.
Four additional detectives have been engaged
by General Yang.

Your obedient Servant,
mmmmmustial
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Entries omitted Aug. 7.

编号
刑事侦缉处
情报官登记
第 502 号
日期 1916年8月8日
上海工部局。
1916年8月7日
（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探分部。）

先生：
宋庆路30号发生炸弹爆炸。
该房屋目前由一名中国裁缝居住，但此前曾被革命党人占用，据信炸弹系由这些人遗留在该处。爆炸未造成严重破坏。住户受重伤。
在昨日举行的市志愿者会议上，他们选举李平书为主席。他拒绝接受该职位。不久将在外滩（华界）的剧院举行另一次会议。
一名军事情报侦探向杨将军报告称，吴淞随时可能切断与中央政府的联系。他还报告称，刘副督军最近自行购买了2,000支步枪。
本月6日，派遣二百人增援漕泾马村驻军。
本月6日凌晨1时，在徐家汇村巡逻期间，一名中国巡捕督察试图逮捕一名劫匪。后者开枪击中该警官大腿后逃脱。
杨将军又聘用了四名侦探。

您顺从的仆人，
mmmmmustial
首席侦探督察。

警察总监上尉。

8月7日条目省略。
